projects.name: SO-101 Robot Arms
projects.summary: Open-source SO-101 leader and follower robot arms with sourcing tables, printable STL plates, optional hardware, and LeRobot setup links.
projects.description: The SO-101 is TheRobotStudio and Hugging Face's next-generation SO-100 arm design, updated for easier assembly, improved wiring, and leader-arm motor changes. The repository provides kit sources, BOM-style sourcing tables, 3D printing guidance, optional mounts and accessories, debugging notes, and official SO-101 leader and follower visuals.
